evidence.description: Housing Ombudsman determination records the resident's complaint history, repair reports, and landlord response.

case.facts: In July 2022 the resident reported a broken fence in her back garden to the landlord. Following her report the landlord attended to inspect, however, it did not complete repairs. The complaint is about the landlord’s response to the fence repair. This investigation has also considered the landlord’s complaint handling.
